33	  fn open_draft(store, badge, period, first_line) =
34	    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
35	    if who is staff.Active then
36	      let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(period)?
37	      if not closed then
38	        let id: ids.ReportId = store.next_id()?
39	        store.save_report({ id: id, badge: badge, department: who.department, period: period, lines: [first_line], status: reports.ReportStatus.Draft, approvals: [] })?
40	        Ok(id)
41	      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
42	    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")
43	
44	  fn add_line(store, report_id, badge, line) =
45	    let o: Own = own(store, report_id, badge)?
46	    if o.r is reports.Editable then
47	      if o.r.lines.length < 50 then store.save_report(reports.add_line(o.r, line))
48	      else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "a report holds at most 50 lines")
49	    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not editable")
50	
51	  fn submit(store, report_id, badge) =
52	    let o: Own = own(store, report_id, badge)?
53	    if o.r is reports.Draft then
54	      open_and_valid(store, o.r)?
55	      store.save_report(reports.submit(o.r))?
56	      store.append_audit(audit.entry(badge, o.r.id, reports.ReportStatus.Draft, reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, "submitted"))
57	    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not a draft")
58	
59	  fn resubmit(store, report_id, badge) =
60	    let o: Own = own(store, report_id, badge)?
61	    if o.r is reports.AwaitingChanges then
62	      open_and_valid(store, o.r)?
63	      store.save_report(reports.resubmit(o.r))?
64	      store.append_audit(audit.entry(badge, o.r.id, reports.ReportStatus.ChangesRequested, reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, "resubmitted"))
65	    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not awaiting changes")
66	
67	  fn approve(store, report_id, approver) =
68	    let g: Gate = gate(store, report_id, approver)?
69	    if g.r.approvals.length + 1 >= routing.steps_for(lines.total(g.r.lines)) then final_approval(store, g.r, g.who)
70	    else
71	      store.save_report(reports.add_approval(g.r, g.who.badge))?
72	      store.append_audit(audit.entry(g.who.badge, g.r.id, reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, "approved; awaiting the next approver"))?
73	      Ok(reports.ReportStatus.Submitted)
74	
75	  fn reject(store, report_id, approver, reason) =
76	    let g: Gate = gate(store, report_id, approver)?
77	    store.save_report(reports.reject(g.r))?
78	    store.append_audit(audit.entry(g.who.badge, g.r.id, reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, reports.ReportStatus.Rejected, reason))
79	
80	  fn request_changes(store, report_id, approver, reason) =
81	    let g: Gate = gate(store, report_id, approver)?
82	    store.save_report(reports.request_changes(g.r))?
83	    store.append_audit(audit.entry(g.who.badge, g.r.id, reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, reports.ReportStatus.ChangesRequested, reason))
84	
85	  fn own(store, report_id, badge) =
86	    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
87	    if who is staff.Active then
88	      let r: reports.Report = store.report(report_id)?
89	      if r.badge == badge then Ok({ r: r, who: who })
90	      else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only the submitter may act on this report")
91	    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")
92	
93	  fn open_and_valid(store, r) =
94	    let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(r.period)?
95	    if closed then Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
96	    else if lines.all_valid(r.lines) then Ok(Done)
97	    else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "a line is over its limit or lacks a required receipt")
98	
99	  fn gate(store, report_id, approver) =
100	    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(approver)?
101	    if who is staff.Active then
102	      let r: reports.Report = store.report(report_id)?
103	      if r is reports.Submitted then
104	        let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(r.period)?
105	        if not closed then
106	          if who.badge != r.badge then
107	            let allowed: Bool = may_act(store, r, who)?
108	            if allowed then Ok({ r: r, who: who })
109	            else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "not this report's next approver")
110	          else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "a report cannot be approved by its submitter")
111	        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
112	      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not awaiting approval")
113	    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")
114	
115	  fn may_act(store, r, who) =
116	    let required: Maybe<ids.Badge> = required_for(store, r)?
117	    if required == None then Ok(who.role in {ids.Role.Finance})
118	    else Ok(who.badge == required)

121	    let role: ids.Role = routing.role_for(r.approvals.length + 1)
122	    if role in {ids.Role.Finance} then Ok(None)
123	    else if role in {ids.Role.Supervisor} then
124	      let submitter: staff.Staff = store.staff(r.badge)?
125	      if submitter.supervisor != None then stand_in(store, submitter.supervisor)
126	      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the submitter has no supervisor")
127	    else
128	      let dept: staff.Department = store.department(r.department)?
129	      stand_in(store, dept.director)
130	
131	  fn stand_in(store, required) =
132	    let person: staff.Staff = store.staff(required)?
133	    if person.active then Ok(required)
134	    else if person.supervisor != None then
135	      let up: staff.Staff = store.staff(person.supervisor)?
136	      if up.active then Ok(person.supervisor)
137	      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "no active approver stands in for " ++ required)
138	    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "no active approver stands in for " ++ required)
139	
140	  fn final_approval(store, r, who) =
141	    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(r.department)?
142	    let others: reports.Reports = store.reports_for(r.department, r.period)?
143	    let within: Bool = budget.spend_of(others) + lines.budgeted_total(r.lines) <= dept.budget
144	    if within or who.role in {ids.Role.Finance} then
145	      let reason: ids.Reason = if within then "approved" else "approved; budget override"
146	      store.save_report(reports.approve(r))?
147	      store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, r.id, reports.ReportStatus.Submitted, reports.ReportStatus.Approved, reason))?
148	      Ok(reports.ReportStatus.Approved)
149	    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the department budget for this period would be exceeded")

module desk.payment
import desk.ids as ids
import desk.lines as lines
import desk.staff as staff
import desk.reports as reports
import desk.audit as audit
import desk.host as host

interface
  fn pay(store: host.Store, ledger: host.Ledger, report_id: ids.ReportId, finance_badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Text>
  fn close_period(store: host.Store, period: ids.Period, finance_badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Done>
body
  fn pay(store, ledger, report_id, finance_badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then
      let r: reports.Report = store.report(report_id)?
      if r is reports.Approved then
        let reference: Text = ledger.pay(r.badge, lines.total(r.lines), r.id)?
        store.save_report(reports.pay(r, reference))?
        store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, r.id, reports.ReportStatus.Approved, reports.ReportStatus.Paid, "paid"))?
        Ok(reference)
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not approved")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only active finance staff may pay")

  fn close_period(store, period, finance_badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then
      let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(period)?
      if closed then Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is already closed")
      else store.close_period(period)
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only active finance staff may close a period")

14	  type Rows      = Array<Row> where it.length in 0 to 1000

18

22	  fn spend(store, department, period) =
23	    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?
24	    let rs: reports.Reports = store.reports_for(dept.id, period)?
25	    Ok(budget.spend_of(rs))

28	    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?
29	    let rs: reports.Reports = store.reports_for(dept.id, period)?
30	    let rows: Rows = []
31	    for r in rs
32	      if r is reports.Counted then rows = rows ++ [{ id: r.id, badge: r.badge, status: r.status, total: lines.total(r.lines), budgeted: lines.budgeted_total(r.lines) }]
33	    let spent: Int = budget.spend_of(rs)
34	    Ok({ department: dept.id, period: period, budget: dept.budget, spend: spent, remaining: dept.budget - spent, rows: rows })

38	    let rs: reports.Reports = store.submitted_reports()?

40	    if who is staff.Active then
41	      for r in rs
42	        if r is reports.Submitted and r.badge != who.badge then
43	          let verdict: Outcome<Bool> = review.may_act(store, r, who)
44	          if verdict is Ok then
45	            let allowed: Bool = verdict?
46	            if allowed then out = out ++ [r.id]
47	    Ok(out)

  type Ids       = Array<ids.ReportId> where it.length in 0 to 1000
  type Row       = { id: ids.ReportId, badge: ids.Badge, status: reports.ReportStatus, total: Int, budgeted: Int }
  type Rows      = Array<Row> where it.length in 0 to 1000
  type Statement = { department: ids.DepartmentId, period: ids.Period, budget: ids.Money, spend: Int, remaining: Int, rows: Rows }

  fn statement(store: host.Store, department: ids.DepartmentId, period: ids.Period) -> Outcome<Statement>

  fn pending_for(store: host.Store, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Ids>

  fn spend(store, department, period) =
    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?
    let rs: reports.Reports = store.reports_for(dept.id, period)?
    Ok(budget.spend_of(rs))

  fn statement(store, department, period) =
    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?
    let rs: reports.Reports = store.reports_for(dept.id, period)?
    let rows: Rows = []
    for r in rs
      if r is reports.Counted then rows = rows ++ [{ id: r.id, badge: r.badge, status: r.status, total: lines.total(r.lines), budgeted: lines.budgeted_total(r.lines) }]
    let spent: Int = budget.spend_of(rs)
    Ok({ department: dept.id, period: period, budget: dept.budget, spend: spent, remaining: dept.budget - spent, rows: rows })

  fn pending_for(store, approver) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(approver)?
    let rs: reports.Reports = store.submitted_reports()?
    let out: Ids = []
    if who is staff.Active then
      for r in rs
        if r is reports.Submitted and r.badge != who.badge then
          let verdict: Outcome<Bool> = review.may_act(store, r, who)
          if verdict is Ok then
            let allowed: Bool = verdict?
            if allowed then out = out ++ [r.id]
    Ok(out)

1	# desk/purchasing.brass
2	module desk.purchasing
3	import desk.ids as ids
4	import desk.staff as staff
5	import desk.routing as routing
6	import desk.records as records
7	import desk.host as host
8	import desk.registry as registry
9	import desk.delegation as delegation
10	
11	interface
12	  fn raise_po(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, badge: ids.Badge, vendor_id: records.VendorId, amount: Int, period: ids.Period) -> Outcome<records.PoId>
13	  fn approve_po(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po_id: records.PoId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<records.PoStatus>
14	  fn reject_po(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po_id: records.PoId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Done>
15	  fn receive_po(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po_id: records.PoId, badge: ids.Badge, received_amount: Int) -> Outcome<Done>
16	  fn close_po(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po_id: records.PoId, finance_badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Done>
17	  fn po_commitments(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, department: ids.DepartmentId, period: ids.Period) -> Outcome<Int>
18	private
19	  type PoGate = { po: records.PoRequested, who: staff.Active }
20	  fn gate(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po_id: records.PoId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<PoGate>
21	  fn accepted(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, po: records.PoRequested, who: staff.Active) -> Outcome<Bool>
22	  fn required_person(store: host.Store, po: records.PoRequested) -> Outcome<ids.Badge>
23	body
24	  fn raise_po(store, reg, badge, vendor_id, amount, period) =
25	    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
26	    if who is staff.Active then
27	      let v: records.Vendor = reg.vendor(vendor_id)?
28	      if v.active then
29	        if amount >= 1 and amount <= 1000000000 then
30	          let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(period)?
31	          if not closed then
32	            let id: records.PoId = store.next_id()?
33	            reg.save_po({ id: id, vendor: vendor_id, requested_by: badge, department: who.department, period: period, amount: amount, status: records.PoStatus.Requested, approvals: [], received: 0 })?
34	            Ok(id)
35	          else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
36	        else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "a PO is for at least 1 cent")
37	      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the vendor is not active")
38	    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")
39	
40	  fn approve_po(store, reg, po_id, approver) =
41	    let g: PoGate = gate(store, reg, po_id, approver)?
42	    if g.po.approvals.length + 1 >= routing.steps_for(g.po.amount) then
43	      let limit: ids.Money = reg.allowance(g.po.department, g.po.period)?
44	      let pos: records.POs = reg.pos_for(g.po.department, g.po.period)?
45	      if records.commitments(pos) + g.po.amount <= limit then
46	        reg.save_po(records.approve_po(g.po))?
47	        Ok(records.PoStatus.Approved)
48	      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the department's PO allowance for this period would be exceeded")
49	    else
50	      reg.save_po(records.add_po_approval(g.po, g.who.badge))?
51	      Ok(records.PoStatus.Requested)
52	
53	  fn reject_po(store, reg, po_id, approver) =
54	    let g: PoGate = gate(store, reg, po_id, approver)?
55	    reg.save_po(records.reject_po(g.po))
56	
57	  fn receive_po(store, reg, po_id, badge, received_amount) =
58	    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
59	    if who is staff.Active then
60	      let po: records.PurchaseOrder = reg.po(po_id)?
61	      if po.requested_by == badge then
62	        if po is records.PoApproved then
63	          if received_amount >= 1 and received_amount <= po.amount then reg.save_po(records.receive_po(po, received_amount))
64	          else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "the received amount is 1 to the PO's amount")
65	        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the PO is not approved")
66	      else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only the requester may receive a PO")
67	    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")
68	
69	  fn close_po(store, reg, po_id, finance_badge) =
70	    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
71	    if who is staff.Finance then
72	      let po: records.PurchaseOrder = reg.po(po_id)?
73	      if po is records.PoReceived then reg.save_po(records.close_po(po))
74	      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the PO is not received")
75	    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only active finance staff may close a PO")
76	
77	  fn po_commitments(store, reg, department, period) =
78	    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?
79	    let pos: records.POs = reg.pos_for(dept.id, period)?
80	    Ok(records.commitments(pos))
81	
82	  fn gate(store, reg, po_id, approver) =
83	    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(approver)?
84	    if who is staff.Active then
85	      let po: records.PurchaseOrder = reg.po(po_id)?
86	      if po is records.PoRequested then
87	        let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(po.period)?
88	        if not closed then
89	          if who.badge != po.requested_by then
90	            let ok: Bool = accepted(store, reg, po, who)?
91	            if ok then Ok({ po: po, who: who })
92	            else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "not this PO's next approver")
93	          else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "a PO cannot be approved by its requester")
94	        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
95	      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the PO is not awaiting approval")
96	    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")
97	
98	  fn accepted(store, reg, po, who) =
99	    let role: ids.Role = routing.role_for(po.approvals.length + 1)
100	    if role in {ids.Role.Finance} then Ok(who.role in {ids.Role.Finance})
101	    else
102	      let required: ids.Badge = required_person(store, po)?
103	      let person: staff.Staff = store.staff(required)?
104	      let deputy: Maybe<ids.Badge> = delegation.delegate_in_force(reg, required, po.period)?
105	      if person.active then Ok(who.badge == required or (deputy != None and who.badge == deputy))
106	      else if deputy != None then Ok(who.badge == deputy)
107	      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the required approver is inactive and has no delegate")
108	
109	  fn required_person(store, po) =
110	    let role: ids.Role = routing.role_for(po.approvals.length + 1)
111	    if role in {ids.Role.Supervisor} then
112	      let requester: staff.Staff = store.staff(po.requested_by)?
113	      if requester.supervisor != None then Ok(requester.supervisor)
114	      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the requester has no supervisor")
115	    else
116	      let dept: staff.Department = store.department(po.department)?
117	      Ok(dept.director)

module desk.exceptions
import desk.ids as ids
import desk.staff as staff
import desk.reports as reports
import desk.records as records
import desk.host as host
import desk.registry as registry

interface
  fn request_exception(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, report_id: ids.ReportId, badge: ids.Badge, position: Int, reason: Text) -> Outcome<records.ExceptionId>
  fn decide_exception(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, exception_id: records.ExceptionId, director_badge: ids.Badge, grant: Bool) -> Outcome<records.ExceptionStatus>
body
  fn request_exception(store, reg, report_id, badge, position, reason) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let r: reports.Report = store.report(report_id)?
      if r.badge == badge then
        if r is reports.Editable then
          if position >= 1 and position <= r.lines.length and reason.length >= 1 and reason.length <= 200 then
            let existing: records.Exceptions = reg.exceptions_for(r.id)?
            if any e in existing where e.position == position and e.status in {records.ExceptionStatus.Pending} then
              Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "an exception for this line is already pending")
            else
              let id: records.ExceptionId = store.next_id()?
              reg.save_exception({ id: id, report: r.id, position: position, badge: badge, reason: reason, status: records.ExceptionStatus.Pending, decided_by: None })?
              Ok(id)
          else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "the position must name a line, and the reason be 1 to 200 characters")
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not editable")
      else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only the submitter may ask for an exception")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn decide_exception(store, reg, exception_id, director_badge, grant) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(director_badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let e: records.PolicyException = reg.exception(exception_id)?
      if e is records.PendingException then
        let r: reports.Report = store.report(e.report)?
        let dept: staff.Department = store.department(r.department)?
        if dept.director == director_badge then
          let decided: records.PolicyException = records.decide(e, grant, director_badge)
          reg.save_exception(decided)?
          Ok(decided.status)
        else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only the department's director may decide an exception")
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the exception is already decided")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

# desk/delegation.brass
module desk.delegation
import desk.ids as ids
import desk.staff as staff
import desk.records as records
import desk.host as host
import desk.registry as registry

interface
  fn grant_delegation(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, delegator: ids.Badge, delegate: ids.Badge, first: ids.Period, last: ids.Period) -> Outcome<records.DelegationId>
  fn revoke_delegation(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, delegation_id: records.DelegationId, badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn delegate_in_force(reg: registry.Registry, badge: ids.Badge, period: ids.Period) -> Outcome<Maybe<ids.Badge>>
body
  fn grant_delegation(store, reg, delegator, delegate, first, last) =
    let giver: staff.Staff = store.staff(delegator)?
    if giver is staff.Active and giver.role in {ids.Role.Supervisor, ids.Role.Director} then
      let taker: staff.Staff = store.staff(delegate)?
      if taker is staff.Active then
        if delegate != delegator and first <= last and last - first <= 11 then
          let existing: records.Delegations = reg.delegations_from(delegator)?
          if any d in existing where not d.revoked and d.first <= last and first <= d.last then
            Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "an existing delegation overlaps these periods")
          else
            let id: records.DelegationId = store.next_id()?
            reg.save_delegation({ id: id, delegator: delegator, delegate: delegate, first: first, last: last, revoked: false })?
            Ok(id)
        else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "a delegation goes to someone else, over 1 to 12 periods in order")
      else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "the delegate is not active")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only an active supervisor or director may delegate")

  fn revoke_delegation(store, reg, delegation_id, badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let d: records.Delegation = reg.delegation(delegation_id)?
      if d.delegator == badge then
        if not d.revoked then reg.save_delegation(d with { revoked: true })
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the delegation is already revoked")
      else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only the delegator may revoke a delegation")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn delegate_in_force(reg, badge, period) =
    let ds: records.Delegations = reg.delegations_from(badge)?
    let found: Maybe<ids.Badge> = None
    for d in ds
      if records.in_force(d, period) then found = d.delegate
    Ok(found)

module desk.allowances
import desk.ids as ids
import desk.lines as lines
import desk.staff as staff
import desk.reports as reports
import desk.records as records
import desk.host as host

interface
  fn add_per_diem(store: host.Store, report_id: ids.ReportId, badge: ids.Badge, region: records.Region, days: Int) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn add_mileage(store: host.Store, report_id: ids.ReportId, badge: ids.Badge, vehicle: records.Vehicle, km: Int) -> Outcome<Done>
private
  fn append(store: host.Store, report_id: ids.ReportId, badge: ids.Badge, l: lines.Line, valid: Bool) -> Outcome<Done>
body
  fn add_per_diem(store, report_id, badge, region, days) =
    let amount: Int = if days >= 1 and days <= 30 then records.per_diem_rate(region) * days else 0
    append(store, report_id, badge, { category: ids.Category.Travel, amount: amount, description: "per diem", receipt: true }, days >= 1 and days <= 30)

  fn add_mileage(store, report_id, badge, vehicle, km) =
    let amount: Int = if km >= 1 and km <= 2000 then records.mileage_rate(vehicle) * km else 0
    append(store, report_id, badge, { category: ids.Category.Travel, amount: amount, description: "mileage", receipt: true }, km >= 1 and km <= 2000)

  fn append(store, report_id, badge, l, valid) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let r: reports.Report = store.report(report_id)?
      if r.badge == badge then
        if r is reports.Editable then
          if r.lines.length < 50 then
            if valid then store.save_report(reports.add_line(r, l))
            else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "days are 1 to 30 and kilometres 1 to 2,000")
          else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "a report holds at most 50 lines")
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not editable")
      else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only the submitter may add to this report")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn onboard_vendor(store, reg, finance_badge, name) =

    if who is staff.Finance then
      let v: records.Vendor = reg.vendor(vendor_id)?
      if v.active then
        let pos: records.POs = reg.pos_of_vendor(v.id)?
        if any p in pos where p.status in {records.PoStatus.Requested, records.PoStatus.Approved} then
          Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the vendor has POs still requested or approved")
        else reg.save_vendor(v with { active: false })
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the vendor is already inactive")

    let sum: Int = 0
    for p in pos
      if p.status in {records.PoStatus.Received, records.PoStatus.Closed} then sum = sum + p.received

# desk/card_limits.brass
module desk.card_limits
import desk.ids as ids
import desk.staff as staff
import desk.records as records
import desk.host as host
import desk.registry as registry

interface
  fn set_card_limit(store: host.Store, reg: registry.Registry, finance_badge: ids.Badge, badge: ids.Badge, limit: Int) -> Outcome<Done>
  fn over_limit(reg: registry.Registry, period: ids.Period) -> Outcome<records.Badges>

  fn spent_by(ts: records.Txns, badge: ids.Badge) -> Int
    after result >= 0
body
  fn set_card_limit(store, reg, finance_badge, badge, limit) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then
      let holder: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
      if limit >= 0 and limit <= 1000000000 then reg.save_card_limit({ badge: holder.badge, limit: limit })
      else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "a card limit is 0 to 1,000,000,000 cents")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only active finance staff may set a card limit")

  fn over_limit(reg, period) =
    let ts: records.Txns = reg.txns_for(period)?
    let seen: records.Badges = []
    let out: records.Badges = []
    for t in ts
      if not (t.status in {records.CardStatus.Disputed}) and not (any s in seen where s == t.badge) then
        seen = seen ++ [t.badge]
        let lim: Outcome<records.CardLimit> = reg.card_limit(t.badge)
        if lim is Ok then
          let l: records.CardLimit = lim?
          if spent_by(ts, t.badge) > l.limit then out = out ++ [t.badge]
    Ok(out)

  fn spent_by(ts, badge) =
    let sum: Int = 0
    for t in ts
      if t.badge == badge and not (t.status in {records.CardStatus.Disputed}) then sum = sum + t.amount
    sum

# desk/records.brass
module desk.records
import desk.ids as ids
import desk.reports as reports

interface
  type VendorId     = Text
  type PoId         = Text
  type TxnId        = Text
  type DelegationId = Text
  type CostCenterId = Text
  type EntityId     = Text
  type Region       = Island | Mainland | Offsite
  type Vehicle      = Car | Truck | Boat
  type Amount       = Int where it in 1 to 1000000000

  machine PoStatus
    states  Requested, Approved, Rejected, Received, Closed
    initial Requested
    Requested enters Approved | Rejected
    Approved  enters Received
    Received  enters Closed

  machine CardStatus
    states  Open, Matched, Disputed
    initial Open
    Open     enters Matched | Disputed
    Disputed enters Open

  type Vendor        = { id: VendorId, name: Text, active: Bool }
  type PurchaseOrder = { id: PoId, vendor: VendorId, requested_by: ids.Badge, department: ids.DepartmentId, period: ids.Period, amount: Amount, status: PoStatus, approvals: reports.Approvals, received: ids.Money }
  type POs           = Array<PurchaseOrder> where it.length in 0 to 1000
  type PoRequested   = PurchaseOrder where it.status in {PoStatus.Requested}
  type PoApproved    = PurchaseOrder where it.status in {PoStatus.Approved}
  type PoReceived    = PurchaseOrder where it.status in {PoStatus.Received}

  type CardTxn  = { id: TxnId, badge: ids.Badge, period: ids.Period, amount: Amount, category: ids.Category, merchant: ids.Description, status: CardStatus, matched: Maybe<ids.ReportId> }
  type Txns     = Array<CardTxn> where it.length in 0 to 1000
  type OpenTxn  = CardTxn where it.status in {CardStatus.Open}

  type Delegation  = { id: DelegationId, delegator: ids.Badge, delegate: ids.Badge, first: ids.Period, last: ids.Period, revoked: Bool }
  type Delegations = Array<Delegation> where it.length in 0 to 100

  type CostCenter = { id: CostCenterId, entity: EntityId, name: Text }
  type Entity     = { id: EntityId, name: Text }
  type DeptIds    = Array<ids.DepartmentId> where it.length in 0 to 50
  type CardLimit  = { badge: ids.Badge, limit: ids.Money }
  type ExceptionId = Text

  machine ExceptionStatus
    states  Pending, Granted, Denied
    initial Pending
    Pending enters Granted | Denied

  type PolicyException = { id: ExceptionId, report: ids.ReportId, position: Int, badge: ids.Badge, reason: ids.Reason, status: ExceptionStatus, decided_by: Maybe<ids.Badge> }
  type Exceptions      = Array<PolicyException> where it.length in 0 to 50
  type PendingException = PolicyException where it.status in {ExceptionStatus.Pending}
  type Badges     = Array<ids.Badge> where it.length in 0 to 1000

  fn commitments(pos: POs) -> Int
    after result >= 0
  fn in_force(d: Delegation, period: ids.Period) -> Bool
    example in_force({ id: "d", delegator: "a", delegate: "b", first: 2, last: 4, revoked: false }, 4) == true
    example in_force({ id: "d", delegator: "a", delegate: "b", first: 2, last: 4, revoked: true }, 3) == false
  fn per_diem_rate(r: Region) -> Int
    example per_diem_rate(Region.Offsite) == 12000
  fn mileage_rate(v: Vehicle) -> Int
    example mileage_rate(Vehicle.Boat) == 250

  fn add_po_approval(po: PoRequested, who: ids.Badge) -> PurchaseOrder
    before po.approvals.length < 2
  fn approve_po(po: PoRequested) -> PurchaseOrder
  fn reject_po(po: PoRequested) -> PurchaseOrder
  fn receive_po(po: PoApproved, received: ids.Money) -> PurchaseOrder
  fn close_po(po: PoReceived) -> PurchaseOrder
  fn decide(e: PendingException, grant: Bool, by: ids.Badge) -> PolicyException
  fn match_txn(t: OpenTxn, report: ids.ReportId) -> CardTxn
  fn dispute_txn(t: OpenTxn) -> CardTxn
body
  fn commitments(pos) =
    let sum: Int = 0
    for p in pos
      if p.status in {PoStatus.Approved} then sum = sum + p.amount
      else if p.status in {PoStatus.Received, PoStatus.Closed} then sum = sum + p.received
    sum

  fn in_force(d, period) = not d.revoked and d.first <= period and period <= d.last

  fn per_diem_rate(r) = if r in {Region.Island} then 9000 else if r in {Region.Mainland} then 6000 else 12000

  fn mileage_rate(v) = if v in {Vehicle.Car} then 60 else if v in {Vehicle.Truck} then 90 else 250

  fn add_po_approval(po, who) = po with { approvals: po.approvals ++ [who] }
  fn approve_po(po)           = po with { status enters PoStatus.Approved }
  fn reject_po(po)            = po with { status enters PoStatus.Rejected }
  fn receive_po(po, received) = po with { status enters PoStatus.Received, received: received }
  fn close_po(po)             = po with { status enters PoStatus.Closed }
  fn decide(e, grant, by)     = if grant then e with { status enters ExceptionStatus.Granted, decided_by: by } else e with { status enters ExceptionStatus.Denied, decided_by: by }
  fn match_txn(t, report)     = t with { status enters CardStatus.Matched, matched: report }
  fn dispute_txn(t)           = t with { status enters CardStatus.Disputed }

interface
  type Ids       = Array<ids.ReportId> where it.length in 0 to 1000
  type Row       = { id: ids.ReportId, badge: ids.Badge, status: reports.ReportStatus, total: Int, budgeted: Int }
  type Rows      = Array<Row> where it.length in 0 to 1000
  type Statement = { department: ids.DepartmentId, period: ids.Period, budget: ids.Money, spend: Int, remaining: Int, rows: Rows }

  fn statement(store: host.Store, department: ids.DepartmentId, period: ids.Period) -> Outcome<Statement>

    let rs: reports.Reports = store.reports_for(dept.id, period)?
    Ok(budget.spend_of(rs))

  fn statement(store, department, period) =
    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?
    let rs: reports.Reports = store.reports_for(dept.id, period)?
    let rows: Rows = []
    for r in rs
      if r is reports.Counted then rows = rows ++ [{ id: r.id, badge: r.badge, status: r.status, total: lines.total(r.lines), budgeted: lines.budgeted_total(r.lines) }]
    let spent: Int = budget.spend_of(rs)
    Ok({ department: dept.id, period: period, budget: dept.budget, spend: spent, remaining: dept.budget - spent, rows: rows })

  fn pending_for(store, approver) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(approver)?
    let rs: reports.Reports = store.submitted_reports()?

          let verdict: Outcome<Bool> = review.may_act(store, r, who)
          if verdict is Ok then
            let allowed: Bool = verdict?
            if allowed then out = out ++ [r.id]
    Ok(out)

# desk/advances.brass
module desk.advances
import desk.ids as ids
import desk.lines as lines
import desk.staff as staff
import desk.reports as reports
import desk.records as records
import desk.audit as audit
import desk.host as host
import desk.routing as routing
import desk.budget as budget

interface
  type AdvanceIds = Array<records.AdvanceId> where it.length in 0 to 1000

  fn request_advance(store: host.Store, badge: ids.Badge, period: ids.Period, amount: Int) -> Outcome<records.AdvanceId>
  fn approve_advance(store: host.Store, advance_id: records.AdvanceId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<records.AdvanceStatus>
  fn pay_advance(store: host.Store, ledger: host.Ledger, advance_id: records.AdvanceId, finance_badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Text>
  fn pay_against(store: host.Store, ledger: host.Ledger, report_id: ids.ReportId, advance_id: records.AdvanceId, finance_badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Text>
  fn outstanding_advances(store: host.Store, today: Int) -> Outcome<AdvanceIds>
private
  type Gate = { a: records.AdvanceRequested, who: staff.Active }

  fn gate(store: host.Store, advance_id: records.AdvanceId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Gate>
  fn may_act(store: host.Store, a: records.AdvanceRequested, who: staff.Active) -> Outcome<Bool>
  fn required_for(store: host.Store, a: records.AdvanceRequested) -> Outcome<Maybe<ids.Badge>>
  fn stand_in(store: host.Store, required: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Maybe<ids.Badge>>
  fn final_approval(store: host.Store, a: records.AdvanceRequested, who: staff.Active) -> Outcome<records.AdvanceStatus>
body
  fn request_advance(store, badge, period, amount) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(period)?
      if not closed then
        if amount >= 1 and amount <= 1000000000 then
          let id: records.AdvanceId = store.next_id()?
          store.save_advance({ id: id, badge: badge, department: who.department, period: period, amount: amount, status: records.AdvanceStatus.Requested, approvals: [] })?
          Ok(id)
        else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "an advance is for at least 1 cent")
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn approve_advance(store, advance_id, approver) =
    let g: Gate = gate(store, advance_id, approver)?
    if g.a.approvals.length + 1 >= routing.steps_for(g.a.amount) then final_approval(store, g.a, g.who)
    else
      store.save_advance(records.add_advance_approval(g.a, g.who.badge))?
      store.append_audit(audit.entry(g.who.badge, g.a.id, records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Requested), records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Requested), "approved; awaiting the next approver"))?
      Ok(records.AdvanceStatus.Requested)

  fn pay_advance(store, ledger, advance_id, finance_badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then
      let a: records.Advance = store.advance(advance_id)?
      if a is records.AdvanceApproved then
        let reference: Text = ledger.pay(a.badge, a.amount, a.id)?
        store.save_advance(records.pay_advance(a, reference))?
        store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, a.id, records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Approved), records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Paid), "paid"))?
        Ok(reference)
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the advance is not approved")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only active finance staff may pay")

  fn pay_against(store, ledger, report_id, advance_id, finance_badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then
      let r: reports.Report = store.report(report_id)?
      if r is reports.Approved then
        let a: records.Advance = store.advance(advance_id)?
        if a is records.AdvancePaid then
          if a.badge == r.badge and a.period == r.period then
            let total: Int = lines.total(r.lines)
            if a.amount >= total then
              let owed: ids.Money = a.amount - total
              store.save_advance(records.settle_advance(a, owed))?
              store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, a.id, records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Paid), records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Settled), "settled"))?
              store.save_report(reports.pay(r, a.reference))?
              store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, r.id, records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Approved), records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Paid), "paid; settled against an advance"))?
              Ok("settled")
            else
              let diff: Int = total - a.amount
              let reference: Text = ledger.pay(r.badge, diff, r.id)?
              store.save_advance(records.settle_advance(a, 0))?
              store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, a.id, records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Paid), records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Settled), "settled"))?
              store.save_report(reports.pay(r, reference))?
              store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, r.id, records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Approved), records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Paid), "paid"))?
              Ok(reference)
          else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the advance and report are not for the same staff member and period")
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the advance is not paid")
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not approved")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only active finance staff may pay")

  fn outstanding_advances(store, today) =
    let paid: records.Advances = store.paid_advances()?
    let out: AdvanceIds = []
    for a in paid
      if a.period + 2 < today then out = out ++ [a.id]
    Ok(out)

  fn gate(store, advance_id, approver) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(approver)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let a: records.Advance = store.advance(advance_id)?
      if a is records.AdvanceRequested then
        let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(a.period)?
        if not closed then
          if who.badge != a.badge then
            let allowed: Bool = may_act(store, a, who)?
            if allowed then Ok({ a: a, who: who })
            else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "not this advance's next approver")
          else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "an advance cannot be approved by its requester")
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the advance is not awaiting approval")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn may_act(store, a, who) =
    let required: Maybe<ids.Badge> = required_for(store, a)?
    if required == None then Ok(who.role in {ids.Role.Finance})
    else Ok(who.badge == required)

  fn required_for(store, a) =

interface
  type AdvanceIds = Array<records.AdvanceId> where it.length in 0 to 1000

  fn pay_against(store: host.Store, ledger: host.Ledger, report_id: ids.ReportId, advance_id: records.AdvanceId, finance_badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Text>
  fn outstanding_advances(store: host.Store, today: Int) -> Outcome<AdvanceIds>

  fn gate(store: host.Store, advance_id: records.AdvanceId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Gate>

    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?

        if amount >= 1 and amount <= 1000000000 then
          let id: records.AdvanceId = store.next_id()?
          store.save_advance({ id: id, badge: badge, department: who.department, period: period, amount: amount, status: records.AdvanceStatus.Requested, approvals: [] })?
          Ok(id)
        else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "an advance is for at least 1 cent")
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn approve_advance(store, advance_id, approver) =
    let g: Gate = gate(store, advance_id, approver)?
    if g.a.approvals.length + 1 >= routing.steps_for(g.a.amount) then final_approval(store, g.a, g.who)
    else
      store.save_advance(records.add_advance_approval(g.a, g.who.badge))?
      store.append_audit(audit.entry(g.who.badge, g.a.id, records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Requested), records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Requested), "approved; awaiting the next approver"))?
      Ok(records.AdvanceStatus.Requested)

  fn pay_advance(store, ledger, advance_id, finance_badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then
      let a: records.Advance = store.advance(advance_id)?
      if a is records.AdvanceApproved then
        let reference: Text = ledger.pay(a.badge, a.amount, a.id)?
        store.save_advance(records.pay_advance(a, reference))?

          if a.badge == r.badge and a.period == r.period then
            let total: Int = lines.total(r.lines)
            if a.amount >= total then
              let owed: ids.Money = a.amount - total
              store.save_advance(records.settle_advance(a, owed))?
              store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, a.id, records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Paid), records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Settled), "settled"))?
              store.save_report(reports.pay(r, a.reference))?
              store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, r.id, records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Approved), records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Paid), "paid; settled against an advance"))?
              Ok("settled")

              let diff: Int = total - a.amount

        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the advance is not paid")

    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only active finance staff may pay")

    let out: AdvanceIds = []

# desk/records.brass
module desk.records
import desk.ids as ids
import desk.reports as reports

interface
  type VendorId     = Text
  type PoId         = Text
  type TxnId        = Text
  type DelegationId = Text
  type CostCenterId = Text
  type EntityId     = Text
  type Region       = Island | Mainland | Offsite
  type Vehicle      = Car | Truck | Boat
  type Amount       = Int where it in 1 to 1000000000

  machine PoStatus
    states  Requested, Approved, Rejected, Received, Closed
    initial Requested
    Requested enters Approved | Rejected
    Approved  enters Received
    Received  enters Closed

  machine CardStatus
    states  Open, Matched, Disputed
    initial Open
    Open     enters Matched | Disputed
    Disputed enters Open

  type Vendor        = { id: VendorId, name: Text, active: Bool }
  type PurchaseOrder = { id: PoId, vendor: VendorId, requested_by: ids.Badge, department: ids.DepartmentId, period: ids.Period, amount: Amount, status: PoStatus, approvals: reports.Approvals, received: ids.Money }
  type POs           = Array<PurchaseOrder> where it.length in 0 to 1000
  type PoRequested   = PurchaseOrder where it.status in {PoStatus.Requested}
  type PoApproved    = PurchaseOrder where it.status in {PoStatus.Approved}
  type PoReceived    = PurchaseOrder where it.status in {PoStatus.Received}

  type CardTxn  = { id: TxnId, badge: ids.Badge, period: ids.Period, amount: Amount, category: ids.Category, merchant: ids.Description, status: CardStatus, matched: Maybe<ids.ReportId> }
  type Txns     = Array<CardTxn> where it.length in 0 to 1000
  type OpenTxn  = CardTxn where it.status in {CardStatus.Open}

  type Delegation  = { id: DelegationId, delegator: ids.Badge, delegate: ids.Badge, first: ids.Period, last: ids.Period, revoked: Bool }
  type Delegations = Array<Delegation> where it.length in 0 to 100

  type CostCenter = { id: CostCenterId, entity: EntityId, name: Text }
  type Entity     = { id: EntityId, name: Text }
  type DeptIds    = Array<ids.DepartmentId> where it.length in 0 to 50
  type CardLimit  = { badge: ids.Badge, limit: ids.Money }
  type ExceptionId = Text

  machine ExceptionStatus
    states  Pending, Granted, Denied
    initial Pending
    Pending enters Granted | Denied

  type PolicyException = { id: ExceptionId, report: ids.ReportId, position: Int, badge: ids.Badge, reason: ids.Reason, status: ExceptionStatus, decided_by: Maybe<ids.Badge> }
  type Exceptions      = Array<PolicyException> where it.length in 0 to 50
  type PendingException = PolicyException where it.status in {ExceptionStatus.Pending}
  type Badges     = Array<ids.Badge> where it.length in 0 to 1000

  type AdvanceId = Text

  machine AdvanceStatus
    states  Requested, Approved, Paid, Settled
    initial Requested
    Requested enters Approved
    Approved  enters Paid
    Paid      enters Settled

  type Advance  = { id: AdvanceId, badge: ids.Badge, department: ids.DepartmentId, period: ids.Period, amount: Amount, status: AdvanceStatus, approvals: reports.Approvals,
      reference: Text when it.status in {AdvanceStatus.Paid, AdvanceStatus.Settled},
      owed: ids.Money when it.status in {AdvanceStatus.Settled} }
  type Advances = Array<Advance> where it.length in 0 to 1000

  type AdvanceRequested = Advance where it.status in {AdvanceStatus.Requested}
  type AdvanceApproved  = Advance where it.status in {AdvanceStatus.Approved}
  type AdvancePaid      = Advance where it.status in {AdvanceStatus.Paid}
  type AdvanceCounted   = Advance where it.status in {AdvanceStatus.Approved, AdvanceStatus.Paid}

  type Step = Draft | Submitted | Approved | Rejected | ChangesRequested | Paid | Requested | Settled

  fn step_of_report(s: reports.ReportStatus) -> Step
    example step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Draft) == Step.Draft
    example step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Submitted) == Step.Submitted
    example step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Approved) == Step.Approved
    example step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Rejected) == Step.Rejected
    example step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.ChangesRequested) == Step.ChangesRequested
    example step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Paid) == Step.Paid

  fn step_of_advance(s: AdvanceStatus) -> Step
    example step_of_advance(AdvanceStatus.Requested) == Step.Requested
    example step_of_advance(AdvanceStatus.Approved) == Step.Approved
    example step_of_advance(AdvanceStatus.Paid) == Step.Paid
    example step_of_advance(AdvanceStatus.Settled) == Step.Settled

  fn add_advance_approval(a: AdvanceRequested, who: ids.Badge) -> Advance
    before a.approvals.length < 2
  fn approve_advance(a: AdvanceRequested) -> Advance
    after result.status in {AdvanceStatus.Approved}
  fn pay_advance(a: AdvanceApproved, reference: Text) -> Advance
    after result.status in {AdvanceStatus.Paid}
  fn settle_advance(a: AdvancePaid, owed: ids.Money) -> Advance
    after result.status in {AdvanceStatus.Settled}

  fn commitments(pos: POs) -> Int
    after result >= 0
  fn in_force(d: Delegation, period: ids.Period) -> Bool
    example in_force({ id: "d", delegator: "a", delegate: "b", first: 2, last: 4, revoked: false }, 4) == true
    example in_force({ id: "d", delegator: "a", delegate: "b", first: 2, last: 4, revoked: true }, 3) == false
  fn per_diem_rate(r: Region) -> Int
    example per_diem_rate(Region.Offsite) == 12000
  fn mileage_rate(v: Vehicle) -> Int
    example mileage_rate(Vehicle.Boat) == 250

  fn add_po_approval(po: PoRequested, who: ids.Badge) -> PurchaseOrder
    before po.approvals.length < 2
  fn approve_po(po: PoRequested) -> PurchaseOrder
  fn reject_po(po: PoRequested) -> PurchaseOrder
  fn receive_po(po: PoApproved, received: ids.Money) -> PurchaseOrder
  fn close_po(po: PoReceived) -> PurchaseOrder
  fn decide(e: PendingException, grant: Bool, by: ids.Badge) -> PolicyException
  fn match_txn(t: OpenTxn, report: ids.ReportId) -> CardTxn
  fn dispute_txn(t: OpenTxn) -> CardTxn
body
  fn commitments(pos) =
    let sum: Int = 0
    for p in pos
      if p.status in {PoStatus.Approved} then sum = sum + p.amount
      else if p.status in {PoStatus.Received, PoStatus.Closed} then sum = sum + p.received
    sum

  fn in_force(d, period) = not d.revoked and d.first <= period and period <= d.last

  fn per_diem_rate(r) = if r in {Region.Island} then 9000 else if r in {Region.Mainland} then 6000 else 12000

  fn mileage_rate(v) = if v in {Vehicle.Car} then 60 else if v in {Vehicle.Truck} then 90 else 250

  fn add_po_approval(po, who) = po with { approvals: po.approvals ++ [who] }
  fn approve_po(po)           = po with { status enters PoStatus.Approved }
  fn reject_po(po)            = po with { status enters PoStatus.Rejected }
  fn receive_po(po, received) = po with { status enters PoStatus.Received, received: received }
  fn close_po(po)             = po with { status enters PoStatus.Closed }
  fn decide(e, grant, by)     = if grant then e with { status enters ExceptionStatus.Granted, decided_by: by } else e with { status enters ExceptionStatus.Denied, decided_by: by }
  fn match_txn(t, report)     = t with { status enters CardStatus.Matched, matched: report }
  fn dispute_txn(t)           = t with { status enters CardStatus.Disputed }

  fn step_of_report(s) =
    if s in {reports.ReportStatus.Draft} then Step.Draft
    else if s in {reports.ReportStatus.Submitted} then Step.Submitted
    else if s in {reports.ReportStatus.Approved} then Step.Approved
    else if s in {reports.ReportStatus.Rejected} then Step.Rejected
    else if s in {reports.ReportStatus.ChangesRequested} then Step.ChangesRequested
    else Step.Paid

  fn step_of_advance(s) =
    if s in {AdvanceStatus.Requested} then Step.Requested
    else if s in {AdvanceStatus.Approved} then Step.Approved
    else if s in {AdvanceStatus.Paid} then Step.Paid
    else Step.Settled

  fn add_advance_approval(a, who) = a with { approvals: a.approvals ++ [who] }
  fn approve_advance(a)           = a with { status enters AdvanceStatus.Approved }
  fn pay_advance(a, reference)    = a with { status enters AdvanceStatus.Paid, reference: reference }
  fn settle_advance(a, owed)      = a with { status enters AdvanceStatus.Settled, owed: owed }

# desk/queries.brass
module desk.queries
import desk.ids as ids
import desk.lines as lines
import desk.staff as staff
import desk.reports as reports
import desk.records as records
import desk.host as host
import desk.budget as budget
import desk.review as review

interface
  type Ids       = Array<ids.ReportId> where it.length in 0 to 1000
  type Row       = { id: ids.ReportId, badge: ids.Badge, status: records.Step, total: Int, budgeted: Int }
  type Rows      = Array<Row> where it.length in 0 to 1000
  type Statement = { department: ids.DepartmentId, period: ids.Period, budget: ids.Money, spend: Int, remaining: Int, rows: Rows }

  fn statement(store: host.Store, department: ids.DepartmentId, period: ids.Period) -> Outcome<Statement>

  fn spend(store: host.Store, department: ids.DepartmentId, period: ids.Period) -> Outcome<Int>
  fn pending_for(store: host.Store, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Ids>
body
  fn spend(store, department, period) =
    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?
    let rs: reports.Reports = store.reports_for(dept.id, period)?
    let advances: records.Advances = store.advances_for(dept.id, period)?
    Ok(budget.spend_of(rs) + budget.advance_counted_total(advances))

  fn statement(store, department, period) =
    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(department)?
    let rs: reports.Reports = store.reports_for(dept.id, period)?
    let advances: records.Advances = store.advances_for(dept.id, period)?
    let rows: Rows = []
    for r in rs
      if r is reports.Counted then rows = rows ++ [{ id: r.id, badge: r.badge, status: records.step_of_report(r.status), total: lines.total(r.lines), budgeted: lines.budgeted_total(r.lines) }]
    for a in advances
      if a is records.AdvanceCounted then rows = rows ++ [{ id: a.id, badge: a.badge, status: records.step_of_advance(a.status), total: a.amount, budgeted: a.amount }]
    let spent: Int = budget.spend_of(rs) + budget.advance_counted_total(advances)
    Ok({ department: dept.id, period: period, budget: dept.budget, spend: spent, remaining: dept.budget - spent, rows: rows })

  fn pending_for(store, approver) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(approver)?
    let rs: reports.Reports = store.submitted_reports()?
    let out: Ids = []
    if who is staff.Active then
      for r in rs
        if r is reports.Submitted and r.badge != who.badge then
          let verdict: Outcome<Bool> = review.may_act(store, r, who)
          if verdict is Ok then
            let allowed: Bool = verdict?
            if allowed then out = out ++ [r.id]
    Ok(out)

24	  type Gate = { r: reports.Submitted, who: staff.Active }
25	  type Own  = { r: reports.Report, who: staff.Active }
26	
27	  fn gate(store: host.Store, report_id: ids.ReportId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Gate>
28	  fn own(store: host.Store, report_id: ids.ReportId, badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Own>

34	  fn open_draft(store, badge, period, first_line) =
35	    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
36	    if who is staff.Active then
37	      let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(period)?
38	      if not closed then
39	        let id: ids.ReportId = store.next_id()?
40	        store.save_report({ id: id, badge: badge, department: who.department, period: period, lines: [first_line], status: reports.ReportStatus.Draft, approvals: [] })?
41	        Ok(id)
42	      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
43	    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")
44	
45	  fn add_line(store, report_id, badge, line) =
46	    let o: Own = own(store, report_id, badge)?
47	    if o.r is reports.Editable then
48	      if o.r.lines.length < 50 then store.save_report(reports.add_line(o.r, line))
49	      else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "a report holds at most 50 lines")
50	    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not editable")
51	
52	  fn submit(store, report_id, badge) =
53	    let o: Own = own(store, report_id, badge)?
54	    if o.r is reports.Draft then
55	      open_and_valid(store, o.r)?
56	      store.save_report(reports.submit(o.r))?
57	      store.append_audit(audit.entry(badge, o.r.id, records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Draft), records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Submitted), "submitted"))
58	    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not a draft")
59	
60	  fn resubmit(store, report_id, badge) =
61	    let o: Own = own(store, report_id, badge)?
62	    if o.r is reports.AwaitingChanges then
63	      open_and_valid(store, o.r)?
64	      store.save_report(reports.resubmit(o.r))?
65	      store.append_audit(audit.entry(badge, o.r.id, records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.ChangesRequested), records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Submitted), "resubmitted"))
66	    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not awaiting changes")
67	
68	  fn approve(store, report_id, approver) =
69	    let g: Gate = gate(store, report_id, approver)?
70	    if g.r.approvals.length + 1 >= routing.steps_for(lines.total(g.r.lines)) then final_approval(store, g.r, g.who)
71	    else
72	      store.save_report(reports.add_approval(g.r, g.who.badge))?
73	      store.append_audit(audit.entry(g.who.badge, g.r.id, records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Submitted), records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Submitted), "approved; awaiting the next approver"))?
74	      Ok(reports.ReportStatus.Submitted)
75	
76	  fn reject(store, report_id, approver, reason) =
77	    let g: Gate = gate(store, report_id, approver)?
78	    store.save_report(reports.reject(g.r))?
79	    store.append_audit(audit.entry(g.who.badge, g.r.id, records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Submitted), records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Rejected), reason))
80	
81	  fn request_changes(store, report_id, approver, reason) =
82	    let g: Gate = gate(store, report_id, approver)?
83	    store.save_report(reports.request_changes(g.r))?
84	    store.append_audit(audit.entry(g.who.badge, g.r.id, records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Submitted), records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.ChangesRequested), reason))
85	
86	  fn own(store, report_id, badge) =
87	    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
88	    if who is staff.Active then
89	      let r: reports.Report = store.report(report_id)?
90	      if r.badge == badge then Ok({ r: r, who: who })
91	      else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only the submitter may act on this report")
92	    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")
93	
94	  fn open_and_valid(store, r) =
95	    let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(r.period)?
96	    if closed then Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
97	    else if lines.all_valid(r.lines) then Ok(Done)
98	    else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "a line is over its limit or lacks a required receipt")
99	
100	  fn gate(store, report_id, approver) =
101	    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(approver)?
102	    if who is staff.Active then
103	      let r: reports.Report = store.report(report_id)?
104	      if r is reports.Submitted then
105	        let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(r.period)?
106	        if not closed then
107	          if who.badge != r.badge then
108	            let allowed: Bool = may_act(store, r, who)?
109	            if allowed then Ok({ r: r, who: who })
110	            else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "not this report's next approver")

112	        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")

114	    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

116	  fn may_act(store, r, who) =
117	    let required: Maybe<ids.Badge> = required_for(store, r)?
118	    if required == None then Ok(who.role in {ids.Role.Finance})
119	    else Ok(who.badge == required)
120	
121	  fn required_for(store, r) =
122	    let role: ids.Role = routing.role_for(r.approvals.length + 1)
123	    if role in {ids.Role.Finance} then Ok(None)
124	    else if role in {ids.Role.Supervisor} then
125	      let submitter: staff.Staff = store.staff(r.badge)?
126	      if submitter.supervisor != None then stand_in(store, submitter.supervisor)

139	    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "no active approver stands in for " ++ required)

module desk.payment
import desk.ids as ids

interface
  fn pay(store: host.Store, ledger: host.Ledger, report_id: ids.ReportId, finance_badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Text>

body
  fn pay(store, ledger, report_id, finance_badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then
      let r: reports.Report = store.report(report_id)?
      if r is reports.Approved then
        let reference: Text = ledger.pay(r.badge, lines.total(r.lines), r.id)?
        store.save_report(reports.pay(r, reference))?

# desk/advances.brass
module desk.advances
import desk.ids as ids
import desk.lines as lines
import desk.staff as staff
import desk.reports as reports
import desk.records as records
import desk.audit as audit
import desk.host as host
import desk.routing as routing
import desk.budget as budget

interface
  type AdvanceIds = Array<records.AdvanceId> where it.length in 0 to 1000

  fn request_advance(store: host.Store, badge: ids.Badge, period: ids.Period, amount: Int) -> Outcome<records.AdvanceId>
  fn approve_advance(store: host.Store, advance_id: records.AdvanceId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<records.AdvanceStatus>
  fn pay_advance(store: host.Store, ledger: host.Ledger, advance_id: records.AdvanceId, finance_badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Text>
  fn pay_against(store: host.Store, ledger: host.Ledger, report_id: ids.ReportId, advance_id: records.AdvanceId, finance_badge: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Text>
  fn outstanding_advances(store: host.Store, today: Int) -> Outcome<AdvanceIds>
private
  type Gate = { a: records.AdvanceRequested, who: staff.Active }

  fn gate(store: host.Store, advance_id: records.AdvanceId, approver: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Gate>
  fn may_act(store: host.Store, a: records.AdvanceRequested, who: staff.Active) -> Outcome<Bool>
  fn required_for(store: host.Store, a: records.AdvanceRequested) -> Outcome<Maybe<ids.Badge>>
  fn stand_in(store: host.Store, required: ids.Badge) -> Outcome<Maybe<ids.Badge>>
  fn final_approval(store: host.Store, a: records.AdvanceRequested, who: staff.Active) -> Outcome<records.AdvanceStatus>
body
  fn request_advance(store, badge, period, amount) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(badge)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(period)?
      if not closed then
        if amount >= 1 and amount <= 1000000000 then
          let id: records.AdvanceId = store.next_id()?
          store.save_advance({ id: id, badge: badge, department: who.department, period: period, amount: amount, status: records.AdvanceStatus.Requested, approvals: [] })?
          Ok(id)
        else Err(FailureCode.InvalidInput, "an advance is for at least 1 cent")
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn approve_advance(store, advance_id, approver) =
    let g: Gate = gate(store, advance_id, approver)?
    if g.a.approvals.length + 1 >= routing.steps_for(g.a.amount) then final_approval(store, g.a, g.who)
    else
      store.save_advance(records.add_advance_approval(g.a, g.who.badge))?
      store.append_audit(audit.entry(g.who.badge, g.a.id, records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Requested), records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Requested), "approved; awaiting the next approver"))?
      Ok(records.AdvanceStatus.Requested)

  fn pay_advance(store, ledger, advance_id, finance_badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then
      let a: records.Advance = store.advance(advance_id)?
      if a is records.AdvanceApproved then
        let reference: Text = ledger.pay(a.badge, a.amount, a.id)?
        store.save_advance(records.pay_advance(a, reference))?
        store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, a.id, records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Approved), records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Paid), "paid"))?
        Ok(reference)
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the advance is not approved")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only active finance staff may pay")

  fn pay_against(store, ledger, report_id, advance_id, finance_badge) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(finance_badge)?
    if who is staff.Finance then
      let r: reports.Report = store.report(report_id)?
      if r is reports.Approved then
        let a: records.Advance = store.advance(advance_id)?
        if a is records.AdvancePaid then
          if a.badge == r.badge and a.period == r.period then
            let total: Int = lines.total(r.lines)
            if a.amount >= total then
              let owed: ids.Money = a.amount - total
              store.save_advance(records.settle_advance(a, owed))?
              store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, a.id, records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Paid), records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Settled), "settled"))?
              store.save_report(reports.pay(r, a.reference))?
              store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, r.id, records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Approved), records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Paid), "paid; settled against an advance"))?
              Ok("settled")
            else
              let diff: Int = total - a.amount
              let reference: Text = ledger.pay(r.badge, diff, r.id)?
              store.save_advance(records.settle_advance(a, 0))?
              store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, a.id, records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Paid), records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Settled), "settled"))?
              store.save_report(reports.pay(r, reference))?
              store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, r.id, records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Approved), records.step_of_report(reports.ReportStatus.Paid), "paid"))?
              Ok(reference)
          else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the advance and report are not for the same staff member and period")
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the advance is not paid")
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the report is not approved")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "only active finance staff may pay")

  fn outstanding_advances(store, today) =
    let paid: records.Advances = store.paid_advances()?
    let out: AdvanceIds = []
    for a in paid
      if a.period + 2 < today then out = out ++ [a.id]
    Ok(out)

  fn gate(store, advance_id, approver) =
    let who: staff.Staff = store.staff(approver)?
    if who is staff.Active then
      let a: records.Advance = store.advance(advance_id)?
      if a is records.AdvanceRequested then
        let closed: Bool = store.period_closed(a.period)?
        if not closed then
          if who.badge != a.badge then
            let allowed: Bool = may_act(store, a, who)?
            if allowed then Ok({ a: a, who: who })
            else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "not this advance's next approver")
          else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "an advance cannot be approved by its requester")
        else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the period is closed")
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the advance is not awaiting approval")
    else Err(FailureCode.Unauthorized, "staff member is not active")

  fn may_act(store, a, who) =
    let required: Maybe<ids.Badge> = required_for(store, a)?
    if required == None then Ok(who.role in {ids.Role.Finance})
    else Ok(who.badge == required)

  fn required_for(store, a) =
    let role: ids.Role = routing.role_for(a.approvals.length + 1)
    if role in {ids.Role.Finance} then Ok(None)
    else if role in {ids.Role.Supervisor} then
      let submitter: staff.Staff = store.staff(a.badge)?
      if submitter.supervisor != None then stand_in(store, submitter.supervisor)
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the requester has no supervisor")
    else
      let dept: staff.Department = store.department(a.department)?
      stand_in(store, dept.director)

  fn stand_in(store, required) =
    let person: staff.Staff = store.staff(required)?
    if person.active then Ok(required)
    else if person.supervisor != None then
      let up: staff.Staff = store.staff(person.supervisor)?
      if up.active then Ok(person.supervisor)
      else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "no active approver stands in for " ++ required)
    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "no active approver stands in for " ++ required)

  fn final_approval(store, a, who) =
    let dept: staff.Department = store.department(a.department)?
    let others: reports.Reports = store.reports_for(a.department, a.period)?
    let advances: records.Advances = store.advances_for(a.department, a.period)?
    let within: Bool = budget.spend_of(others) + budget.advance_counted_total(advances) + a.amount <= dept.budget
    if within or who.role in {ids.Role.Finance} then
      let reason: ids.Reason = if within then "approved" else "approved; budget override"
      store.save_advance(records.approve_advance(a))?
      store.append_audit(audit.entry(who.badge, a.id, records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Requested), records.step_of_advance(records.AdvanceStatus.Approved), reason))?
      Ok(records.AdvanceStatus.Approved)
    else Err(FailureCode.Conflict, "the department budget for this period would be exceeded")

content.text:
I've implemented cash advances across the Brass codebase. Summary of what changed:

- **`src/desk/records.brass`**: added `AdvanceId`, the `AdvanceStatus` machine (Requested→Approved→Paid→Settled), the `Advance`/`Advances` type and its refinements, pure transition helpers (`add_advance_approval`, `approve_advance`, `pay_advance`, `settle_advance`), and a shared `Step` vocabulary (`step_of_report`/`step_of_advance`) per the reference's "field for states of several machines" rule, since `audit.Entry` and the statement's `Row` now need to represent both `ReportStatus` and `AdvanceStatus` transitions.
- **`src/desk/audit.brass`**: widened `Entry.was/now` from `reports.ReportStatus` to `records.Step`; updated every call site in `review.brass`/`payment.brass`/the new `advances.brass` to convert via `records.step_of_report`/`step_of_advance`.
- **`src/desk/host.brass`**: added `Store.advance`, `advances_for`, `paid_advances`, `save_advance`.
- **`src/desk/budget.brass`**: added `advance_counted_total`.
- **`src/desk/review.brass`**: `final_approval`'s department-budget check now also counts advances (bidirectional with the new budget rule).
- **`src/desk/queries.brass`**: `spend`/`statement` now include counted advances; `Row.status` widened to `records.Step`.
- **`src/desk/advances.brass`** (new module): `request_advance`, `approve_advance` (duplicating review's approval-gate logic, since Brass has no generics to share it), `pay_advance`, `pay_against` (settlement logic), `outstanding_advances`.
- **`src/system.brass`** / **`README.md`**: registered the five new entry points and the new module.

**(1) Missing/unclear:** no types were given for the new entry points' plain params (`amount`, `today`); no guidance on whether `audit.Entry`/`queries.Row` needed widening (only inferable from the reference's "shared vocabulary" rule); no wording for new audit reasons; no explicit tie-break for "covers the whole report" at exact equality.

**(2) Most unnecessary work:** reverse-engineering and duplicating `review.brass`'s private approval-gate (`gate`/`may_act`/`required_for`/`stand_in`/`final_approval`) for advances, since Brass's nominal typing and lack of generics forbid sharing it directly — required reading nearly every module to confirm this duplication (e.g. in `purchasing.brass`) really is the codebase's convention. A smaller but annoying snag: discovering `as` is a reserved keyword after already writing `let as: records.Advances = ...` in two files, requiring a rename pass.

**(3) Assumptions the task didn't settle:**
- New entry points live in a new `desk.advances` module.
- `Advance`/`AdvanceStatus`/`Step` live in `desk.records` (parallel to `PurchaseOrder`).
- `audit.Entry.was/now` and `queries.Row.status` are widened to the shared `records.Step` rather than adding a parallel type.
- `request_advance`'s `amount` is plain `Int`, checked inline 1..1,000,000,000 (mirroring `raise_po`); `outstanding_advances`'s `today` is plain `Int`.
- "Covers the whole report" is `advance.amount >= total` (equality owes 0); partial coverage always records `owed = 0` on the advance.
- `pay_against` also emits an audit entry for the report's Approved→Paid transition (mirroring `payment.pay`'s existing convention), even though the task's audit bullet only names the advance's own transitions.
- The department-budget check was made bidirectional: approving a report now also counts advances, and approving an advance counts other reports, in the same department/period.
- `forecasting`/`reporting`/`entities`/`readiness` were left untouched since the task only named `spend`/`statement` and the budget check.
